title: Encoding a Boolean circuit tree
statement: Encode a literal with index $i$ and polarity $s$ as a false bit, followed by $s$, followed by $i$ true bits and then a false bit. Encode an AND or OR node by a true bit, its Boolean gate label, the encodings of its children each preceded by a true bit, and a final false bit.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
A literal index in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and its Boolean polarity
A node gate label and list of child circuits
